name: Logicanvas Product Tours
author: logicanvasio

sections.description:
Logicanvas Product Tours lets you create modern, branded product tours without slowing down your site.

  • Target existing #id and .class selectors from the Tour Studio — no theme edits required
  • Brand kit: colors, radius, fonts, overlay, and live preview
  • Process controls: auto/manual start, audience, show-once with version bump, require-click steps
  • Featherweight: assets load only when a tour matches the page
  • Shortcode, Gutenberg trigger block, and LCProductTour.start(id) API

Product page: https://plugins.logicanvas.io/product-tour-by-logicanvas

Documentation: http://docs.logicanvas.io/product-tour-by-logicanvas

Pro add-on (separate plugin): Elementor Tour Trigger widget, visual element picker, query/scroll triggers, multi-page resume, and completion analytics.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/logicanvas-product-tours
  2. Activate Logicanvas Product Tours through the Plugins screen
  3. Go to Logicanvas Product Tours → Add New and build steps in the Tour Studio
  4. Publish and visit a matching page
sections.faq:
Will this slow down my site?

No. When no tour matches the current page, the plugin loads zero frontend CSS/JS.

Can I use my theme’s existing classes and IDs?

Yes. Each step accepts any CSS selector (#header, .btn-primary, nested selectors, [data-id]).

Does it work with Elementor?

The free plugin works with any markup Elementor outputs via CSS selectors. The Pro add-on adds a Tour Trigger widget and visual picker.
